thread:
emma: alert: CI verify step failed — SAST aborted because KMS decrypt for artifact signature returned PermissionDenied during nightly. Step name: `kms-decrypt-step`.
raj: log snippet?
cole: paste from pipeline:
```
ERROR: KMS Decrypt failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = caller does not have permission to use resource 
resource: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci-keys/cryptoKeys/artifact-signing-2024
```
zane: I see an org-policy cleanup ran that removed inactive groups flagged by the `iam-inactivity-remediation` job. It removed `group:ci-artifact-access@redwood`. That group was bound at key-level.
emma: ugh. Short-term fix: grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to `ci-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` scoped to that cryptoKey. Minimal scope.
raj: applied scoped grant and linked change to SEC-5999. Confirmed decrypt OK and pipeline retriggered.
sonar-bot: SAST queued: previous scan had medium-confidence remote-template injection in `templates/config.tpl`. Will re-run post-unseal.
cole: timeline & audit: there is a SetIamPolicy at 2026-10-02T01:12:08Z removing the group (actor: iam-cleaner@redwood). I exported the Decrypt audit entry and SetIamPolicy diff to the ticket. Use filters: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt"' --limit=20` and `--filter='protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy"'`.
emma: follow-ups: 1) prevent automated cleanup from removing key-level bindings without PR approval — add a denylist in the cleanup job and a preflight gate that calls `gcloud kms keys testIamPermissions` for any key referenced. 2) improve decrypt wrapper to surface job_name, key path, and a link to SetIamPolicy log when failing. 3) run SAST triage for flagged templates and avoid auto-suppression.
zane: plan: - update `infra/cleanup` to consult `infra/config/iam-protected.json` and skip protected groups, - add `ci/verify_kms_access.sh` which runs:
```
gcloud kms keys testIamPermissions artifact-signing --keyring=ci-keys --location=global --permissions=cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
- add pre-merge job when PR touches `iam/` or `infra/cleanup`.
raj: opened PRs for the scoped RBAC patch + preflight check, and added an audit tag SEC-5999.
cole: SAST re-run: template issue appears to be a false positive due to templating syntax; I'll add a one-line suppression with rationale and link the suppression entry to the ticket. If there is any historical commit with real secrets, we'll rotate and escalate.
emma: note for security review workflow: add a checklist item "verify KMS key-level bindings for CI & Dedicated runners" and require evidence (log snippets) before closing infra cleanup PRs. Also record the remediation steps in the Security Review doc.
secops-bot: Reminder: link follow-ups to SEC-5999 and ensure retention of audit logs for 90 days per compliance policy.
emma: closing incident: CI green at 01:29Z; SEC-5999 remains open for the preflight PR and cleanup whitelist. Thanks all :thumbsup:
